en: A panoramic black‑and‑white view of a coastal town built around a curved bay. Whitewashed, flat‑roofed houses line the waterfront, with a small harbor and several boats. Low hills and islands appear in the background across the calm sea. In the foreground are scattered buildings and rocky terrain. Printed captions in Greek and French identify the location, and a modern website watermark is visible along the bottom right.
